definitions.explanation: A negative evaluation or reception of something. Used when a product, decision, or action is poorly received by others.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{不評|ふひょう}だった。
⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦デザイン→デザイン：03860_dezain⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{社員|しゃいん}→社員：03065_shain⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{不評|ふひょう}で、⟦{変更|へんこう}→変更：03616_henkou⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The new design was unpopular with employees and was changed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{値上|ねあ}げ→値上げ：07582_neage⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{消費者|しょうひしゃ}→消費者：09866_shouhisha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{間|あいだ}→間：00914_aida⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{大|おお}いに→大いに：01609_ooini⟧{不評|ふひょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}っている→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: The price increase is drawing a great deal of criticism from consumers.

notes:
USAGE:
Often used with ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧ (to draw criticism/unpopularity) as a set expression. Can function as a な-adjective ({不評|ふひょう}な⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧ — an unpopular movie).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {不評|ふひょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧ (to draw criticism, to be poorly received)
- {不評|ふひょう}だった (was unpopular)
- {不評|ふひょう}な⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧ (an unpopular opinion)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{好評|こうひょう}→好評：16720_kouhyou⟧: good reputation, popularity — the direct opposite
- ⟦{評判|ひょうばん}→評判：03586_hyouban⟧: reputation — neutral, can be good or bad
